cd /tmp/ws && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import parse

# Test exact match behavior with different alignments
tests = [
    ('{:<}', 'hello'),
    ('{:<}', 'hello '),
    ('{:<}', 'hello   world'),
    ('{:^}', 'hello'),
    ('{:^}', ' hello '),
    ('{:>} ', ' hello'),
]

for pattern, string in tests:
    p = parse.compile(pattern)
    r = p.parse(string)
    print(f"parse({pattern!r}, {string!r}): {r}")
    
    r2 = p.search(string)
    print(f"search({pattern!r}, {string!r}): {r2}")
    print()
